# tModLoader

> > Official modding framework for Terraria, enabling players to create, install, and manage custom content using C# and the Steam Workshop.

tModLoader is an open-source modding framework that extends Terraria with comprehensive APIs (ModItem, ModNPC, ModTile) and tools for mod development. The platform supports cross-platform installation on Windows, macOS, and Linux, with integrated Steam Workshop publishing and an in-game Mod Browser featuring popular mods like Magic Storage, Recipe Browser, and Auto Reforge.

## Key Topics

- tModLoader framework
- Terraria modding
- Steam Workshop integration
- C# API (ModItem, ModNPC, ModTile)
- Mod Browser
- Cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux)
- Visual Studio and .NET SDK development
- Magic Storage mod
- Recipe Browser mod
- GitHub repository
- Mod publishing and distribution
- Multiplayer mod synchronization
- Open-source modding tools
- Discord community
